about.heroHeadline1: We built Hélène because the system
about.heroDescription: Menopause affects every woman. Yet most face it without real information, without daily support, and without anyone connecting the dots. We decided to change that.
about.storyCard1p1: "One woman in my family was told she'd face severe symptoms. She spent months bracing for the worst — letting that fear shape her days.
about.storyCard1p2: She had barely any symptoms. The worry itself had become the burden."
about.storyCard2p1: "The other didn't know she was going through menopause. The mood changes, the disrupted sleep, the fog — nobody told her any of it was connected.
about.storyCard2p2: She went through years of it alone."
about.storyResolution: Two women. Two opposite failures of a system that should have been there for both.
about.storyClosing: That gap — between too much fear and not enough awareness — is exactly why we built Hélène.
about.stat1desc: spent in perimenopause, menopause, or post-menopause
about.stat3desc: yet most never connect them to the transition
about.stat4desc: leave a doctor's office with an actual plan
about.missionHeadline: Clarity, continuity, and confidence — every day.
about.missionDescription: Not a pamphlet. Not a ten-minute appointment. A daily companion that tracks, explains, and reminds you that you're not alone.
about.valuesHeadline: Three principles behind everything we build
about.v1body: We turn scattered symptoms into understandable patterns — so you can finally see what's going on.
about.v2body: Every feature is built on clinical research, from the MRS scale to evidence-based guidance.
about.v3body: Daily support, real data, and a community of women who understand because they're living it too.
about.teamHeadline: Built by people who give a damn
about.teamDescription: Four data science students from Albert School × Mines Paris, building the tool that should have existed already.
about.advisorText: Looking for menopause specialists to join our scientific board.
